firstAttempt.reason: Ninja RC include dependency was missing: About compiled the new version while VERSIONINFO retained the previous version. Added OBJECT_DEPENDS for generated/version.h and rebuilt both configurations. Existing About/resource equality E2E then passed.

screenshot.latestVersion: 99.0.0 test example, not a published release

boundaries.externalApis: HTTP-boundary mocks, including GitHub release metadata and installer/CDN bytes; no unregistered fallback
boundaries.actualWindows: Native UI, disk writes, SHA-256, updater handoff and process restart; local collectors and input in windows-real
boundaries.installer: Dedicated mock process in TestHost only. Real NSIS install/uninstall, registry mutation and production-only installed-version validation not exercised because a user installation exists
boundaries.liveApiIntegration: Not requested or executed by app tests
boundaries.longDuration: Final candidate has a short single-PC check only; older 30-minute/two-PC/soak results remain historical
boundaries.isolation: Installed process, layout, backups and startup registration preserved; only owned TestHost instances stopped

publication: Candidate only; public artifact verification is recorded in a post-publication receipt
